# Letters — Style Reference

> Rounded stationery sliding out of a pale-sky envelope. Open Runde at weight 600 on a white #ffffff canvas, no line work at all, and one glacier blue reserved for microphones, envelopes and waveforms.

**Theme:** light

Values are measured from the live site and normalized; names, roles and recommendations are interpretation. Font lists are independent, not paired by position. Example prompts describe reconstructions, not the site's source code.

Letters uses a soft-stationery clinical language: a medical documentation tool presented as rounded paper goods. The canvas is Paper Canvas #ffffff (68 background uses). Fog Wash #fafafa and Pebble Card #f5f5f5 are the only surface steps. A single inset hero panel carries a sky gradient from Dusk Sky #7b9cc4 to Mist Sky #c8dff0. The chromatic budget is one hue. Glacier Signal #2597d0 and its Frosted Tint #c0eaff appear only on product icons, waveform bars and the blue cast of floating-mockup shadows, while the primary action stays Jet Ink #070709. Typography is one rounded grotesk, Open Runde. It carries hierarchy through size and a firm 600 weight: an 80px display, 44px section heads, and heading steps steeper than 1.5×, with tracking pulled to -4% at display sizes. Every shape is rounded: 100px pills, 48px cards and 18px inner tiles. Elevation comes from blue-tinted shadows rather than borders, and the page has no borders at all. It reads as a friendly writing desk rather than a hospital records system.

## Tokens — Colors

| Mist Sky | `#c8dff0` | `--color-mist-sky` | Bottom stop of the hero gradient (estimated), where the envelope illustration emerges — fades the hero toward the white canvas below. |

## Tokens — Typography

### Open Runde — the single rounded grotesk for display, headings, body and actions · `--font-open-runde`

- **Substitute:** Open Runde itself is freely licensed (SIL OFL), so use it at 600 wherever possible. Second choice is Inter at 600: it shares Open Runde's skeleton exactly and draws at the same stroke weight, but loses the rounded terminals. Third choice is Nunito at 700: Nunito draws lighter than its nominal weight, so step up one weight to match Open Runde 600.
- **Weights:** 400, 500, 600, 700, 900
- **Sizes:** 12, 13, 14, 16, 17, 18, 20, 28, 44, 80
- **Line height:** 0.9 at 80px, 1.1 at 44px, 1.2 at 28px, 1.4 for body sizes, 1.5 at 14px UI text, 1.333 at 12px
- **Letter spacing:** -3.2px at 80px, -1.76px at 44px, -0.84px at 28px, -0.2px at 20px, -0.18px at 18px, -0.17px at 17px, -0.16px at 16px, -0.14px at 14px, -0.08px at 13px, 0px at 12px
- **Role:** Open Runde is the signature. It is Inter re-cut with rounded stroke ends, so the type is friendly before any color or illustration appears. The 600 weight at 80px and 44px gives firm authority, and the rounding keeps that authority from turning stern. The scale is deliberately steep: 44 to 80 is 1.82×, and 28 to 44 is 1.57×. Both steps sit well above a Perfect Fourth (1.333), so size alone separates the display from everything else. Tracking scales with size, from -1% at body sizes to -4% at display sizes, which keeps the 80px headline compact and lets two lines stack tightly at a 0.9 line height.

### Inter — the navigation micro-label face · `--font-inter`

- **Substitute:** Inter is open source, so use it at 500 directly. Alternatives are Geist at 500, which draws about the same weight, and Manrope at 500, which draws slightly lighter and should be checked against the white-on-sky contrast.
- **Weights:** 400, 500
- **Sizes:** 14
- **Line height:** 1.5
- **Letter spacing:** -0.14px at 14px
- **Role:** Inter appears only in the 11 center nav links ("Use cases", "Features", "Pricing", "Our doctors"). The unrounded terminals make the nav quieter than the rounded content beneath it. This is the system's one concession to convention: navigation reads as utility while the content reads as stationery.

### The Doctor FreeVersion — the handwritten "before" state, decorative and mockup-internal · `--font-the-doctor-freeversion`

- **Substitute:** Homemade Apple at 400, La Belle Aurore at 400 or Mrs Saint Delafield at 400. All are thin, scrawled scripts that match the low-contrast pen stroke. Avoid brush scripts, which draw noticeably bolder.
- **Weights:** 400
- **Sizes:** 14, 38
- **Line height:** 1.4 at 14px, 0.9 at 38px
- **Letter spacing:** -0.14px at 14px, -0.38px at 38px
- **Role:** This script exists only to show the problem: a doctor's handwritten letter in Dove Hint, set against the typed "After" version in Open Runde. Its 7 uses are all inside illustration. It is narrative contrast rather than a brand voice and has no place in UI.

### Type Scale

| Role | Family | Weight | Size | Line Height | Letter Spacing | Token |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| small | Open Runde | 400 | 12px | 1.333 | 0px | `--text-small` |
| caption | Open Runde | 400 | 13px | 1.45 | -0.08px | `--text-caption` |
| body-sm | Open Runde | 500 | 14px | 1.5 | -0.14px | `--text-body-sm` |
| body | Open Runde | 400 | 16px | 1.4 | -0.16px | `--text-body` |
| body-lg | Open Runde | 600 | 17px | 1.4 | -0.17px | `--text-body-lg` |
| subheading | Open Runde | 400 | 18px | 1.4 | -0.18px | `--text-subheading` |
| heading-sm | Open Runde | 600 | 20px | 1.4 | -0.2px | `--text-heading-sm` |
| heading | Open Runde | 500 | 28px | 1.2 | -0.84px | `--text-heading` |
| heading-lg | Open Runde | 600 | 44px | 1.1 | -1.76px | `--text-heading-lg` |
| display | Open Runde | 600 | 80px | 0.9 | -3.2px | `--text-display` |

## Do's and Don'ts

### Do

- Render every action as a 100px-radius pill with 12px 24px padding and a 17px weight-600 label — the capsule is the only button shape the system knows.
- Set display and section headings in Open Runde 600 with tracking at -4% (-3.2px at 80px, -1.76px at 44px) — the rounded terminals supply warmth, so the weight can stay firm.
- Keep the primary CTA in Jet Ink #070709 with the five-layer lg shadow — black reads as a pen stroke and stays the darkest object on any screen.
- Nest Paper Canvas #ffffff tiles at 18px inside Pebble Card #f5f5f5 slabs at 48px — radius steps down as depth increases, which makes containment legible without lines.
- Tint floating-object shadows blue, using rgba(22, 106, 196, 0.17) at 0px 7px 7px — the cast echoes Glacier Signal, so shadows read as daylight rather than grime.
- Ration Glacier Signal #2597d0 to icons, waveforms and check marks, at about 10 elements per page — rationed blue reads as a product mark, while spread blue reads as a theme.
- Run body copy in Slate Body #60606c at 16px and ledes at 18px with a 1.4 line height — the violet-leaning gray keeps clinical text calm next to Jet Ink titles.

### Don't

- Don't add 1px borders to cards, chips or inputs — the extracted border-color list is empty, and separation comes from #f5f5f5 against #ffffff, so a hairline reintroduces the spreadsheet look the site avoids.
- Don't square anything below the 10px small-element radius — a 4px button or card breaks the roundness thesis and turns soft stationery back into enterprise clinical software.
- Don't fill the primary CTA with Glacier Signal #2597d0 — a blue button is the default for health SaaS, and it would make the accent the loudest thing on the page.
- Don't use neutral black shadows such as rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25) on floating mockups — gray shadows muddy the sky palette, whereas the system's casts are rgba(22, 106, 196) and rgba(36, 36, 40) at 0.17 or less.
- Don't drop section headings to weight 400 at 44px — the hierarchy depends on 600 against a 400 body, and a light heading leaves the steep scale carrying size with no conviction.
- Don't use The Doctor FreeVersion for any UI text, labels or pull quotes — the script is non-negotiably confined to the "before" illustration, because handwriting is the problem the product removes.
- Don't compress desktop section spacing below 80px — never let bands touch, because the spacious 100px rhythm is what makes each rounded slab read as a separate object on a white desk.

## Agent Prompt Guide

**Quick Color Reference**

- canvas: #ffffff (Paper Canvas)
- card surface: #f5f5f5 (Pebble Card)
- heading text: #151515 (Carbon Heading)
- body text: #60606c (Slate Body)
- caption text: #868c98 (Steel Caption)
- accent: #2597d0 (Glacier Signal)
- hero gradient: #7b9cc4 (Dusk Sky)
- primary action: #070709 (filled action)

**Color in Data**

Charts and bars use Glacier Signal #2597d0 only as thin solid strokes or narrow bars on a Frosted Tint #c0eaff track, with all axes, labels and gridlines in Steel Caption #868c98, so the blue stays smaller in area than any Jet Ink #070709 button on the same screen.

**Example Component Prompts**

1. Build a primary action button: an inline-flex capsule with background #070709, text color #ffffff, no border, border-radius 100px, padding 12px 24px and height 48px. Set the label in Open Runde at 17px, weight 600, line-height 1.4 and letter-spacing -0.17px. Apply box-shadow `rgba(36, 36, 40, 0.1) 0px 1px 2px 0px, rgba(36, 36, 40, 0.09) 0px 3px 3px 0px, rgba(36, 36, 40, 0.05) 0px 6px 4px 0px, rgba(36, 36, 40, 0.01) 0px 11px 4px 0px, rgba(36, 36, 40, 0) 0px 17px 5px 0px`. Use no icon, and use the copy "Sign up for free".

2. Build the hero section: an inset panel with an 8px margin from the viewport, border-radius 40px, and a background of linear-gradient(180deg, #7b9cc4 0%, #c8dff0 100%). Place a transparent 64px nav row at the top. Below it, center a stack starting 40px under the nav. The h1 is "Patients, not paperwork" in Open Runde 80px, weight 600, line-height 0.9, letter-spacing -3.2px and color #ffffff, breaking into two lines. Add a 20px gap, then a three-line lede in Open Runde 18px, weight 400, line-height 1.4 and color #ffffff, with key phrases at weight 600. Add a 24px gap, then the #070709 primary pill. Finish with an envelope illustration whose bottom is clipped by the panel radius.

3. Build a feature card: background #f5f5f5, no border, border-radius 48px and padding 40px, placed in a 2-column grid with a 24px gap inside a 1400px container. At the top, place a label chip: background #ffffff, border-radius 100px, padding 6px 12px, a 16px #2597d0 line icon, an 8px gap, and the label "Transcribe" in Open Runde 16px weight 600 in #070709, with box-shadow `rgba(228, 229, 231, 0.24) 0px 1px 2px 0px`. Add a 20px gap, then a title in Open Runde 28px, weight 500, line-height 1.2, letter-spacing -0.84px and color #070709. Center a vignette, then pin a bottom-left link pill: background #ffffff, border-radius 100px, padding 12px 24px, text "About Transcribe" in Open Runde 17px weight 600 #070709 with a chevron after a 10px gap.

4. Build the navigation bar: height 64px, transparent background, relative position (not sticky), and 20px horizontal padding. On the left, place a 20px line-icon logo and the "Letters" wordmark in #ffffff. In the center, place links in Inter 14px, weight 500, letter-spacing -0.14px and color #ffffff at 90% opacity, with 24px gaps and small chevrons on "Use cases" and "Features". On the right, place "Login" in Open Runde 17px weight 600 #ffffff, then a 16px gap, then a pill with background #ffffff, text #60606c, border-radius 100px, padding 12px 24px and height 48px, labeled "Sign up".

5. Build a floating transcription widget: background #ffffff, border-radius 32px and padding 16px. Apply box-shadow `rgba(22, 106, 196, 0.01) 0px 0.42px 0.42px 0px, rgba(22, 106, 196, 0.04) 0px 1.6px 1.6px 0px, rgba(22, 106, 196, 0.17) 0px 7px 7px 0px`. At the top, place transcript text in Open Runde 13px, line-height 1.45 and color #bec2ca. Add a 12px gap, then a waveform track: background #c0eaff, border-radius 100px, height 36px, with a #efeff1 cancel dot on the left, vertical 2px bars in #2597d0 with 4px spacing, and a #2597d0 check dot on the right.

## Components

### Pill Button — Ink (Primary)

**Role:** The single filled call to action

This is a dense black capsule. It uses a Jet Ink #070709 background and Paper Canvas #ffffff text, with no border, a 100px radius, 12px 24px padding and a 48px height. The label is Open Runde at 17px, weight 600, with -0.17px tracking. It carries the five-layer lg shadow, which grounds the capsule with a soft stacked fall-off. Black rather than Glacier Signal is deliberate and anti-convention for health software: the button reads as a fountain-pen mark rather than a hospital-portal link.

### Pill Button — Paper (Secondary)

**Role:** Nav sign-up and secondary entry

This is the light counterpart to the primary pill. It uses a Paper Canvas #ffffff background and Slate Body #60606c text, with no border, a 100px radius, 12px 24px padding and a 48px height. The label is Open Runde at 17px, weight 600, and the button carries no shadow. Over the hero's Dusk Sky gradient it reads as a soft, muted capsule that sits beside the plain "Login" text link. Use it wherever a second action must exist without competing with the Jet Ink pill.

### Chevron Link Pill — About

**Role:** Tertiary card exit link

This is a white capsule inside gray. It uses a Paper Canvas #ffffff background and Jet Ink #070709 text, with no border, a 100px radius and 12px 24px padding. The label is Open Runde at 17px, weight 600, followed by a 10px gap and a small chevron, with no shadow. It sits at the bottom-left of each Pebble Card ("About Letters", "About Transcribe"). The white-on-#f5f5f5 contrast replaces both an outline and an underline, so tonal contrast is the only signal of interactivity.

### Navigation Bar — Transparent Over Sky

**Role:** Top-level wayfinding inside the hero

This is a floating, unfilled bar. It has a transparent background over the Dusk Sky gradient, a 64px height, and relative rather than sticky positioning. The Letters wordmark sits left in Paper Canvas #ffffff. Center links use Inter at 14px, weight 500, with -0.14px tracking, rendered in Paper Canvas at 90% opacity with small chevrons on "Use cases" and "Features". On the right sit a "Login" text link in Open Runde at 17px, weight 600, then the Paper secondary pill. The bar dissolves into the hero rather than sitting on top of it.

### Hero Sky Panel

**Role:** Inset gradient stage for headline

This is a framed morning sky. The panel is inset 8px from the viewport edge, with a 40px radius on all corners. It carries a vertical gradient from Dusk Sky #7b9cc4 to Mist Sky #c8dff0 and no border or shadow. Its contents are centered: the 80px weight-600 Paper Canvas headline with -3.2px tracking, an 18px Open Runde lede, and the Jet Ink pill. The envelope illustration rises from the bottom edge and is cropped by the radius. Treating the hero as an object rather than a full-bleed band is the roundness thesis applied at page scale.

### Feature Card — Pebble

**Role:** Primary product feature container

This is a large, soft slab and the workhorse container. It uses a Pebble Card #f5f5f5 background, no border, a 48px radius, 40px padding and no shadow, in a two-column grid with a 24px gap. A label chip opens the card, followed by a 28px Open Runde weight-500 title in Jet Ink #070709 with -0.84px tracking, a centered product vignette, and a chevron link pill anchored bottom-left. The 48px radius is the largest content radius in the system, and it makes each feature read as a tray rather than a box.

### Label Chip — Icon + Product Name

**Role:** Names the product inside cards

This is a tiny white capsule. It uses a Paper Canvas #ffffff background, no border, a 100px radius and 6px 12px padding. A 16px line icon in Glacier Signal #2597d0 sits 8px before a label in Open Runde at 16px, weight 600, in Jet Ink #070709, with the subtle shadow. This is one of the few places blue is permitted, and it works as punctuation rather than decoration: the blue tags the product without coloring the copy.

### Upload Tile — Inner

**Role:** Mock form control inside cards

This is a nested white tile. It uses a Paper Canvas #ffffff background, no border, an 18px radius and 10px 12px padding. The primary line is Open Runde at 14px, weight 500, in Jet Ink #070709, and the secondary line ("Choose documents") is Steel Caption #868c98 at the same size. A sibling input row uses the same 18px radius with Dove Hint #bec2ca placeholder text. The step from 48px down to 18px is the system's nesting rule: radius shrinks as depth increases.

### Transcription Widget — Floating

**Role:** Live dictation product vignette

This is a hovering mini-app. It uses a Paper Canvas #ffffff background, no border, a 32px radius, 16px padding and the blue md shadow. Transcript text is Open Runde at 13px in Dove Hint #bec2ca and fades as if still arriving. Below it, a waveform track has a Frosted Tint #c0eaff fill, a 100px radius and Glacier Signal #2597d0 bars, with a Pewter Well #efeff1 cancel dot and a blue check dot. This is the one component where blue occupies real area, which is allowed because it depicts sound rather than interface.

### Before/After Letter Mockup

**Role:** Hero narrative illustration

This is the envelope as proof. Two paper sheets rise from a white envelope with an 18px radius. The left sheet uses The Doctor FreeVersion at 14px in Dove Hint #bec2ca, and the right sheet uses Open Runde at 14px in Slate Body #60606c ("Dear Dr Turner,"). Each sheet carries a tab chip with a 100px radius, Paper Canvas fill and an Open Runde 17px weight-600 label in Slate Body, under the md-2 shadow. It is the system outlier: the only place a script face appears, and it is allowed because it shows the problem being solved.

### Inline Heading Glyph

**Role:** Icon embedded mid-headline

This is an object set into a sentence. It is a small square tile with a 10px radius, a Paper Canvas #ffffff background, the sm shadow and a Frosted Tint #c0eaff illustration. It sits inline at cap height inside the 44px Carbon Heading #151515 headline ("Save [glyph] hours a week"), with 8px of space on each side. It turns the section heading into a rebus, which is warmer than a conventional eyebrow label and keeps blue at thumbnail scale.

### Centered Section Heading

**Role:** Opens each content band

This is a two-line centered statement. It uses Open Runde at 44px, weight 600, with a 1.1 line height and -1.76px tracking, in Carbon Heading #151515 with no background. It is held to a narrow measure so it breaks into two short lines, with 40px below it before the card grid. The heading carries no eyebrow and no subtitle, so size and weight alone do the hierarchy work.

## Do's and Don'ts

### Do

- Render every action as a 100px-radius pill with 12px 24px padding and a 17px weight-600 label — the capsule is the only button shape the system knows.
- Set display and section headings in Open Runde 600 with tracking at -4% (-3.2px at 80px, -1.76px at 44px) — the rounded terminals supply warmth, so the weight can stay firm.
- Keep the primary CTA in Jet Ink #070709 with the five-layer lg shadow — black reads as a pen stroke and stays the darkest object on any screen.
- Nest Paper Canvas #ffffff tiles at 18px inside Pebble Card #f5f5f5 slabs at 48px — radius steps down as depth increases, which makes containment legible without lines.
- Tint floating-object shadows blue, using rgba(22, 106, 196, 0.17) at 0px 7px 7px — the cast echoes Glacier Signal, so shadows read as daylight rather than grime.
- Ration Glacier Signal #2597d0 to icons, waveforms and check marks, at about 10 elements per page — rationed blue reads as a product mark, while spread blue reads as a theme.
- Run body copy in Slate Body #60606c at 16px and ledes at 18px with a 1.4 line height — the violet-leaning gray keeps clinical text calm next to Jet Ink titles.

### Don't

- Don't add 1px borders to cards, chips or inputs — the extracted border-color list is empty, and separation comes from #f5f5f5 against #ffffff, so a hairline reintroduces the spreadsheet look the site avoids.
- Don't square anything below the 10px small-element radius — a 4px button or card breaks the roundness thesis and turns soft stationery back into enterprise clinical software.
- Don't fill the primary CTA with Glacier Signal #2597d0 — a blue button is the default for health SaaS, and it would make the accent the loudest thing on the page.
- Don't use neutral black shadows such as rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25) on floating mockups — gray shadows muddy the sky palette, whereas the system's casts are rgba(22, 106, 196) and rgba(36, 36, 40) at 0.17 or less.
- Don't drop section headings to weight 400 at 44px — the hierarchy depends on 600 against a 400 body, and a light heading leaves the steep scale carrying size with no conviction.
- Don't use The Doctor FreeVersion for any UI text, labels or pull quotes — the script is non-negotiably confined to the "before" illustration, because handwriting is the problem the product removes.
- Don't compress desktop section spacing below 80px — never let bands touch, because the spacious 100px rhythm is what makes each rounded slab read as a separate object on a white desk.

## Imagery

The site uses no photography. All imagery is stylized product illustration rendered as UI: an envelope releasing a handwritten and a typed letter, white upload tiles with red PDF badges (mockup-internal color, not a system token), and a floating transcription widget with a waveform. Every illustration sits directly on a surface with no frame. Tiles take an 18px radius, widgets take 32px, and floating pieces carry the blue md or md-2 shadows rather than borders. Icons are thin rounded line icons at 16px in Glacier Signal #2597d0, and the stroke matches the rounded terminals of Open Runde. The only gradient is the hero sky, from Dusk Sky #7b9cc4 to Mist Sky #c8dff0. It is a single decorative backdrop and is not reused as a card or button token. The narrative is paperwork turning into a finished letter.

## Layout

Content sits inside a 1400px container on a white canvas, with 100px between sections and 40px between a section heading and its grid. The hero is an inset rounded panel with an 8px gutter and a 40px radius. It holds a centered stack: the 80px two-line headline, an 18px three-line lede, the Jet Ink pill, and an envelope illustration cropped by the panel's bottom edge. Below the hero, bands alternate between a centered 44px heading and a two-column grid of 48px-radius Pebble Card slabs. Tall Fog Wash zones host scroll-driven demos ("How Letters works"). The feature grid is 2 columns with a 24px gap, and no logo or pricing rows appear on the home page. The 64px nav is transparent, sits inside the hero and is not sticky: wordmark left, links centered, Login and pill right. The extracted samples contain no footer, so build it as a Fog Wash band with 40px padding. At 375px, set the hero headline at the 44px heading-lg size, collapse grids to 1 column, and use 52px section gaps. Density: spacious.

## Rounded Bedside Manner

The discipline is that nothing on the page has a hard corner. Type terminals are rounded by Open Runde. Every action is a 100px pill, cards are 48px slabs, the hero panel is 40px, widgets are 32px and inner tiles are 18px. Even the smallest glyph tile takes 10px. This is how a medical-records product earns warmth without illustration-heavy cuteness: geometry does the reassurance. The system breaks when a single 4px element appears, such as a square data table, a sharp dropdown or a hairline-ruled form. That element reads as the hospital IT the brand positions against. To extend the system, pick radii from the existing ladder (10, 18, 32, 40, 48, 100px) by nesting depth: the outermost container gets the largest value, and each inward step drops one rung.

## Glacier Rationing

The chromatic budget is exactly one hue, and it is rationed by function. Glacier Signal #2597d0 marks product identity (chip icons), sound (waveform bars) and completion (check dots). Its tint #c0eaff provides area when blue needs to fill a track or tile. Everything else is ink and gray: the CTA is #070709, and the copy is #60606c and #151515. Even the shadows carry the hue only as a 0.17-alpha cast. The discipline breaks when blue becomes a button fill, a section background or a heading color, at which point the page reads as generic health SaaS. To extend it, add new states as tints of Glacier Signal rather than new hues, and keep any added status color (error, warning) at chip scale, matching the blue.

## Handwriting As Antagonist

The site's second typeface is a villain. The Doctor FreeVersion renders the illegible handwritten letter in pale Dove Hint #bec2ca at 14px. Directly beside it, the same letter appears in Open Runde at 14px in Slate Body #60606c. The contrast between scrawl and rounded grotesk is the product's argument made in type. The script carries meaning only because it is quarantined to the "before" state. Using it for a testimonial, a signature flourish or a 38px decorative heading would turn the antagonist into a brand voice and collapse the story. To extend the system, reuse the pairing only in before/after demonstrations, and keep the script lighter in color than any Open Runde text on the same surface.

## Similar Brands

- **Heidi Health** — an AI medical scribe that also sells clinicians time back from documentation, but it leans on a deeper brand color where Letters keeps its CTA in near-black #070709.
- **Granola** — an AI note tool that sells transformation of raw input into finished prose through before/after demonstrations, with a similarly sparse, gray-on-white product vignette style.
- **Nabla** — a clinical AI copilot that targets the same audience with light canvases and floating product widgets, though with sharper corners than Letters' 48px slabs.
- **Arc (The Browser Company)** — the closest match for roundness as personality: oversized radii, soft blue-tinted shadows and capsule controls that make software feel like a physical object.
- **Things 3 (Cultured Code)** — shares the white-tile-on-gray-tray nesting and the blue reserved for check marks and small state indicators rather than surfaces.
